description: Painted interior scene. A bearded man in a brown draped tunic sits on a low wooden stool, holding the wrist and open hand of a pale-robed woman who reclines or sits on the left, with her eyes half closed. Behind them is a dark stone wall with shelves holding rolled scrolls, bottles and a jug. On the right a lit candle stands beside a brass bowl on a small wooden table, and a larger brass vessel above drips water into it. The lighting is dim and warm, with no visible frame or text.
